THEMIDDLENURSEFATHEROUTIS-PUNTING.title: Punting!
THEMIDDLENURSEFATHEROUTIS-STOMPING.descr:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.

THEMIDDLENURSEFATHEROUTIS-STOMPING.title: Stomping!

Deal {Damage:diff()} damage twice.
Consume {GrudgeConsume:diff()} [gold]Grudge[/gold] to gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
THEMIDDLENURSEFATHEROUTIS-WEIGHTED_CHAIN:
Gain {SelfBleedPower:diff()} [gold]Bleed[/gold].
This turn, each attack hit applies {BleedPower:diff()} [gold]Bleed[/gold].
[gold]Lævateinn[/gold]: Also apply that much [gold]Burn[/gold].
THEMIDDLENURSEFATHEROUTIS-READY_TO_WRITE:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
Increase the amount of times your [gold]Payback[/gold] can be performed by 1.
THEMIDDLENURSEFATHEROUTIS-WE_REMEMEBER.d:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
If you performed a [gold]Payback[/gold] last turn, hit an additional time and add 1 [gold]Wound[/gold] to your [gold]Discard Pile[/gold].
THEMIDDLENURSEFATHEROUTIS-CROSS_UP.descr:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Apply {BleedPower:diff()} [gold]Bleed[/gold].
If this is the first attack played this turn, gain {Energy:energyIcons()} and draw {Cards:diff()} card.
THEMIDDLENURSEFATHEROUTIS-CROSS_UP.title: Cross Up
THEMIDDLENURSEFATHEROUTIS-RETALIATION.de:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
This turn, [gold]Payback[/gold] performed applies [gold]Bleed[/gold] equal to damage dealt.
[gold]Lævateinn[/gold]: Also apply that much [gold]Burn[/gold].
THEMIDDLENURSEFATHEROUTIS-WEAK_HORIZONTA:
[gold]Fervor[/gold]: Apply [gold]Burn[/gold] an additional time.
Deal {Damage:diff()} Damage to ALL enemies.
Apply {BurnApply:diff()} [gold]Burn[/gold] to ALL enemies
THEMIDDLENURSEFATHEROUTIS-RECITE_VENGEAN:
Gain {Block:diff()}[gold] Block[/gold].
Gain {IncreasedBlock:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold] for each enemy attacking.
THEMIDDLENURSEFATHEROUTIS-REFRESHING_FLO: Gain {Energy:energyIcons()} for the first {ValidEnergy:diff()} times, you play a [gold]Punch[/gold], [gold]Kick[/gold] or [gold]Swing[/gold] this turn, and add a [gold]Wound[/gold] to your discard pile for each {Energy:energyIcons()} gained this way.
THEMIDDLENURSEFATHEROUTIS-DISTAIN.title: Disdain
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to a random enemy {HitAmount:diff()} times.
Consume {GrudgeConsume:diff()} [gold]Grudge[/gold] to hit {AdditionalHitAmount:diff()} additional times.
THEMIDDLENURSEFATHEROUTIS-BIDE_TIME.desc:
Discard {Cards:diff()} random cards.
Next turn, put {Cards:diff()} Attacks from your [gold]Discard Pile[/gold] to [gold]Hand[/gold] and gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
THEMIDDLENURSEFATHEROUTIS-MILD_INCON.des:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
When drawn without [gold]Lævateinn[/gold], this card deals {DamageRemoved:diff()} less damage for the rest of combat.
[gold]Lævateinn[/gold]: When this card is drawn, gain {GrudgeGain:diff()} [gold]Grudge[/gold].
THEMIDDLENURSEFATHEROUTIS-WRITE_SINS.des:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Gain {PaybackGained:diff()} [gold]Payback[/gold].
This turn, apply {VunPower:diff()} [gold]Vulnerable[/gold] After activating [gold]Payback[/gold].
THEMIDDLENURSEFATHEROUTIS-DONT_BREAK_NOW:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Apply 1 [gold]Vulnerable[/gold] for each Seal removed.
[gold]Lævateinn[/gold]: Apply equal amounts [gold]Weak[/gold] and [gold]Exhaust[/gold].
THEMIDDLENURSEFATHEROUTIS-BAD_ASS_ASS_KI:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage {HitAmount:diff()} times. Apply {BleedPower:diff()} [gold]Bleed[/gold] each hit.
[gold]Lævateinn[/gold]: Hit {AdditionalHitAmount:diff()} additional times.
THEMIDDLENURSEFATHEROUTIS-GUT_CRUSH.desc:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Consume {GrudgeConsume:diff()} [gold]Grudge[/gold] to apply {BleedPower:diff()} [gold]Bleed[/gold] to ALL enemies.
THEMIDDLENURSEFATHEROUTIS-STAND_GROUND.d:
Gain {TotalBlock:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
Reduce [gold]Block[/gold] gained by {ReducedBlockGain:diff()} every use this combat.
THEMIDDLENURSEFATHEROUTIS-STRIKE_BACK.de:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Deal {AdditionalDamage:diff()} additional damage if the enemy is attacking.
THEMIDDLENURSEFATHEROUTIS-PAYBACK_WITH_I:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Hit an additional time if you took damage Last turn.
THEMIDDLENURSEFATHEROUTIS-RIGHT_PLEXUS.d:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
If the last card played was a [gold]Punch[/gold], gain {GrudgeGained:diff()} [gold]Grudge[/gold].
If the next card played is a [gold]Swing[/gold], gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
[gold]Lævateinn[/gold]: Apply 1 [gold]Weak[/gold] and {BleedPower:diff()} [gold]Bleed[/gold].
THEMIDDLENURSEFATHEROUTIS-CRIPPLING_BLOW:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Consume {GrudgeConsume:diff()} [gold]Grudge[/gold] to apply 1 [gold]Weak[/gold] and gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
